title: The kb: hook drops the feedback: line from a none pack, though gate g2 and tools.md say it prints it
goal: The kb: hook's web-route context keeps the feedback: line of a weak or none pack beside HEAD_LINES and the pack: line (kb_hook.routed), or tools.md is corrected to say it does not; a test of kb_hook.respond on a none pack asserts the chosen behaviour.

run: import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import kb_hook; r = json.dumps(kb_hook.respond('kb: zzqx frobnicate the quux widget lattice')[0]); print(r[-200:]); sys.exit(0 if 'feedback: kb_feedback' in r else 1)
